description:
Copper Point of Sale is open. A file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\clothing_inventory.csv contains the store's Clothing & Apparel inventory (20 items with names, prices, costs, and quantities). Your tasks as store manager preparing for the seasonal clearance sale:

1. Import the inventory items from C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\clothing_inventory.csv into Copper's item/inventory list.

2. After importing, apply these pricing adjustments to the Clothing & Apparel items:
   - CLEARANCE: Any item with current quantity of 30 or more units is overstocked. Reduce its price by exactly 20% (round to nearest cent).
   - PREMIUM: Any item with current quantity of 7 or fewer units is low stock. Increase its price by exactly 15% (round to nearest cent).

3. After making all price changes, export the complete inventory list from Copper to:
   C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\clearance_inventory.csv

The pricing_reference.csv on your Desktop shows the original prices and quantities for reference. You must identify which items qualify for each adjustment by checking their quantities — no list of specific items is provided.
